name: Switch
purpose: On/off setting that applies at once, with no visible label; the row title names it. Used for Reduced motion and Show completed tasks on settings-general. Named Switch, not Toggle, because shadcn's Toggle is a pressed button with a different role. Merge record: A and B both describe Switch with the same single recorded look, so they are merged. From A: forcedOn prop dropped (critique: it duplicates disabled plus checked); the forced state is checked plus disabled, with a reason prop added. From B: the single-value size axis is dropped (critique: pointless, and the catalogue says no size axis is invented).

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Writes reduced_motion or show_completed as '1' or '0'.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No effect on click. Forced on = checked plus disabled (Reduced motion only, under Low Power Mode or macOS Reduce Motion on desktop).

props.name: reason
props.description: Visible or announced reason shown when the switch is forced on (for example Low Power Mode). Proposed per the critique; the catalogue does not specify the reason copy.

states: disabled and forced on (checked plus disabled; Reduced motion only)
keyboard: Tab focuses. Space toggles (ARIA switch pattern; proposed in A, not recorded in the catalogue). Enter also activates through the native button (B). Conflict between A and B on Enter; both kept, to confirm.
platform: Forced-on source differs. Desktop: Low Power Mode and macOS Reduce Motion. Web: the catalogue gives no equivalent; a browser prefers-reduced-motion setting is a candidate but unconfirmed. Storage differs: desktop writes the local SQLite settings; web needs a per-account setting (proposed). Show completed tasks is the same on both.
open: 1) Look not measured (look null in both rows), so there are no size or colour values; the widget uses the shared tokens. 2) Show completed tasks defaults to on; its effect on the task list is not recorded. 3) Whether web forces reduced motion from the OS preference is unconfirmed. 4) Whether a disabled switch stays focusable (aria-disabled) or leaves the Tab order is not recorded. 5) Reason copy for the forced-on state is not specified (see reason prop).
